name: alaminn-ai-os
description: ALAMINN AI-OS service gateway (LiteLLM minimal deployment; use docker-compose.ai-os.yml for the full stack)

LITELLM_MASTER_KEY.description: Master key for the LiteLLM proxy (min 32 chars; openssl rand -hex 32). Also register this key in ALAMINN /admin/integrations.

ALAMINN_ECOSYSTEM_API_KEY.description: The ALAMINN ecosystem bridge key used by AI-OS services to call /api/v1/ecosystem/* on the main site.
